content:
Sonos last week unveiled several new features coming to its app, and the first batch of upgrades has arrived with the "Sonos 27" app update. Details below.

Below are the new features in Sonos 27 software and what's coming soon, as described by Sonos

Following the naming convention of iOS 27 and other platforms, Sonos' software platform will adopt the "Sonos 27" naming scheme.

Sonos 27 officially launched on the App Store today. Is your current hardware supported? Sonos says "all Sonos S2 products" are compatible, though some features may vary by product.

Here's what Sonos announced is available starting today:

  • Portable surround sound: "Two identical Sonos portable speakers (Move 2 or Sonos Play) can be paired as rear surround speakers compatible with a soundbar, and once moved apart they revert to their original use, allowing existing hardware to do more without a dedicated home theatre setup."
  • Brand-new Sonos 27 app interface: "Redesigned app with simpler controls, featuring swipe gestures and pinned rooms for quick control."
  • Headphone linking (early access): "Once Ace Ultra headphones are linked to a Sonos system, users can push or pull audio directly between nearby speakers and headphones without using their phone as a relay."
  • Sonos 27 MCP (early access): "Connect AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude to Sonos, giving users more choices and not locking them into a single assistant."

Sonos also previewed two features coming soon:

  • Sonos 27 Voice (later this autumn): "Sonos' own music-focused assistant, emphasising that no single AI should control the home, keeping consumer choice at its core."
  • Sonos Custom Agent (2027): "Users can customise agents within the system, with each agent able to select different AI models, personas and voices."

Sonos caused quite a stir a few years ago when it rolled out a major app redesign. This time around the new interface looks like a much smaller change — hopefully it won't spark another controversy.

What do you think of the changes in the Sonos 27 app? Feel free to share in the comments.
